title: How to Choose a Multi-Carrier Delivery Platform | Ingrid

facts.fact: Ingrid's own Delivery Intelligence Platform data shows 32% of shoppers choose the cheapest delivery option at checkout.
facts.quote: Across Ingrid Delivery Intelligence Platform, 32% choose the cheapest delivery option, 17% prioritize speed, 35% have no clear preference, and the rest decide on personal factors.

facts.fact: Ingrid's own Delivery Intelligence Platform data shows 17% of shoppers prioritize speed at checkout.
facts.quote: Across Ingrid Delivery Intelligence Platform, 32% choose the cheapest delivery option, 17% prioritize speed, 35% have no clear preference, and the rest decide on personal factors.

facts.fact: Ingrid's own Delivery Intelligence Platform data shows 35% of shoppers have no clear preference for delivery at checkout.
facts.quote: Across Ingrid Delivery Intelligence Platform, 32% choose the cheapest delivery option, 17% prioritize speed, 35% have no clear preference, and the rest decide on personal factors.

facts.fact: Ingrid states that a multi-carrier delivery platform lifts conversion about 27% on average.
facts.quote: a multi-carrier delivery platform lets you match the right carrier and method to each order, which lifts conversion ~27% on average

facts.fact: Ingrid states that multi-carrier delivery platforms have helped retailers grow shipping revenue by 12–82%.
facts.quote: has helped retailers grow shipping revenue 12–82%

facts.fact: Ingrid's guide says buyers should score delivery platforms on five criteria beyond carrier count: carrier orchestration, checkout impact, delivery accuracy, analytics, and cost control.
facts.quote: score them on five other things besides carrier count: carrier orchestration, checkout impact, delivery accuracy, analytics, and cost control

facts.fact: Ingrid's guide is aimed at mid-market and enterprise e-commerce and omnichannel retailers evaluating or rethinking their delivery setup.
